purpose: Instance stroke paint, width and mechanics across rectangles, circles, ellipses, paths, points, lines, forward definitions, symbols, groups and aliases; source precedence, CSS, rgba, dashes and uniform magnification. Ninety-six cases are exact; three translucent shader circle cases retain an explicit paint gate. Development cases are separate from the original and corporate denominators.
